# AGENTS.md — 15-eco-nonprofit

Instructions for AI coding agents working in this folder.

## Context
- Template: **Second Growth**, eco nonprofit, style "Field survey notebook".
- Stack: Astro 7. Do not add dependencies unless the user asks.
- The design contract is in `DESIGN.md`. Read it before changing anything visual.

## Files
- `src/content.ts` — rings (per-year data), plots, species, log, all copy (EN + RU)
- `src/pages/index.astro` — contour + ring generators, markup, client script
- `src/styles/global.css` — tokens at the top
- `src/components/T.astro` — bilingual text helper

## How to run
- `npm install          # Node 22.23+ (Astro 7)`
- `npm run dev`
- `npm run build   # ./dist`

## Rules
- Content changes go to the content file, not into markup or components.
- Every user-facing string exists in **en** and **ru**. English is the default; `?lang=ru` and the language button switch it.
- Colors, fonts, radii and spacing are tokens. Change tokens, not individual elements.
- Keep the signature block: Tree-ring impact chart: one ring per year, width = trees planted, tap a ring for the numbers.
- Keep accessibility: semantic headings, visible focus, alt text, `prefers-reduced-motion` support, body text contrast ≥ 4.5:1.
- Keep it static: no backend, no booking or payment flows.
- Orange flagging tape is the only accent — plots, flags, the active ring.
- Contour lines are generated at build time; tweak HILLS to reshape the land.
- Literata for headings and field notes, Golos Text for UI.
- Numbers are real-looking and honest: show survival, not just planted.
- No leaf icons, no green gradients.

## Done means
- The page builds/opens without console errors.
- Both languages render with no missing strings.
- Layout works from 360 px to 1920 px wide.
